session_goal: Migrate old chain (stock_service) Layer A/B/C/D logic to new chain (stock_processing_service) architecture, including collection pipeline from subprocess scripts to Runner-based service execution, with end-to-end frontend testing via 日采集控制台
current_task: Fixing systematic Decimal JSON serialization bug in postgres_manager.py and AuctionSnapshotRunner Namespace gaps; one test failure remains (leader_llm command count changed from 3 to 4)
constraints: Must replicate old chain logic exactly, not invent new logic
Must use new chain architecture (ports/gateway/adapters, no direct SQL in Domain)
Collection pipeline must migrate from subprocess scripts to Runner-based execution
jyhf/tushare data ingestion scripts are Phase 5 (last to migrate)

decisions.decision: Completely rebuild Layer C with old chain StrongStockTrackingService logic, discarding Universe/Seed/Refresh/Prune/Promote/RollForward/Admission pipeline
decisions.reason: New chain pipeline produced 365 stocks vs old chain's 30-80, making Layer D impossible

decisions.decision: Implement CollectionTaskRunner Protocol + Registry pattern with multi-step CollectionTaskPlan, migrate tushare_kline 5 steps to Runners
decisions.reason: Eliminate subprocess overhead while keeping backward compatibility via ScriptCommandRunner

decisions.decision: Add __getattr__ to DBThemeDataGateway and DBStockObjectGateway for automatic method delegation to DatabaseGateway
decisions.reason: Avoid adding methods one-by-one as each new Runner triggers missing method errors

decisions.decision: Add _json_default and _safe_json_dumps helpers to postgres_manager.py, replace all naked json.dumps() calls in JSONB write paths
decisions.reason: Decimal objects from Domain scoring layer cause 'Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable' errors at ~25 different write paths

decisions.decision: Change TUSHARE_URL from http://api.tushare.pro to https://api.tushare.pro; fix TushareAdapter(token) signature (was passing config object as token)
decisions.reason: HTTP URL caused API failures; config object as token caused 'your token is incorrect' errors

decisions.decision: Fix rule_row cross-subject leak, prev_candidate_map from evidence_json, jyhf_hot_mainline_flag, cluster bootstrap rule_is_main_theme sync
decisions.reason: Code-level bugs causing incorrect upgrade trigger and identity decisions

decisions.decision: Align fade_watch/fade_confirmed/divergence formulas and 6-dim evidence count to old chain exactly
decisions.reason: 3/5 scoring formulas had fundamentally different computations from old chain

decisions.decision: Add pandas_ta BB lower support, RSI oversold bonus, multi-support resonance bonus
decisions.reason: New chain had only 4 support types vs old chain's 10; 神剑 had support_type=none before fix

decisions.decision: Add promote_strong_watch_candidates, prune_strong_watch_pool Gateway methods with real SQL UPDATE; add history snapshot writes; add watch_window_days persistence
decisions.reason: C layer was only counting in-memory without performing actual DB lifecycle operations

decisions.decision: Change BuildPreMarketBriefJob to read get_prior_strong_watch_pool_rows instead of get_subject_stock_pool_by_trade_date
decisions.reason: D2 should consume D1 candidate pool, not rescan full market
